narrative.heading: A clinic-wide approach to welcoming care
narrative.text: In a June 20, 2023 interview, while he was an assistant professor at the University of Minnesota and directed its Dermatology Gender Care Clinic, Mansh described inclusion as a clinic-wide effort that begins at registration: staff beyond physicians also need preparation for conversations with gender-diverse patients. He spoke about some patients arriving after negative experiences in medical settings and the need to rebuild trust, and said this work was rewarding. These are his 2023 Minnesota-context reflections, not a description of current UCSF procedures, a policy or coverage statement, or a promise of patient outcomes.
